guidance.summary: Annual capex guidance of INR 12 billion to 16 billion through FY30
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: Capital expenditure for the quarter was ₹ 4.1 billion, in -line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.

guidance.summary: Targeting FMEG segment growth at 1.5 to 2x industry growth rate
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: Within Project Spring, we are now targetting to grow this business at roughly 1.5 to 2x of the industry growth.

guidance.summary: Targeting FMEG EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY30
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: We remain confident in the long- term potential of our FMEG business, continuing to align our efforts with Project Spring, targeting 1.5 to 2x of industry growth and improving EBITDA margins to 8% to 10% range by FY30.

guidance.summary: Cables and Wires long-term EBITDA margin guidance of 11% to 13%
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: It is more like 5 -year guidance, and that is where we've given an 11% to 13% of EBITDA margins in the cables and wires business as our guidance.

guidance.summary: Expecting 12% to 14% margins from the BharatNet order book
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: As far as the profitability is concerned, we expect to accrue almost 12% to 14% of margins in that order book as well, which is pretty much in line with what we currently are making.

guidance.summary: EPC segment revenue contribution target of 5% to 10%
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: And overall, if you take near to midterm, the contribution from EPC business will continue to be in 5% to 10% range, which is where we are hovering right now.
